/bin/bash -lc "runuser -u deos-author -- env -i PATH=/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin HOME=/home/deos-author NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS=/etc/cloudflare/certs/cloudflare-containers-ca.crt bash -c 'node - <<'\\''NODE'\\''
const fs = require('\\''fs'\\'')
const path = '\\''openspec/changes/sac-245/tasks.md'\\''
let text = fs.readFileSync(path, '\\''utf8'\\'')
text = text.replace(/- \\[ \\] ((?:1|2|3|4)\\.[1-5]\\b)/g, '\\''- [x] "'$1'"'\\'')
text = text.replace('\\''- [ ] 4.6 '\\'', '\\''- [x] 4.6 '\\'')
fs.writeFileSync(path, text)
NODE
tee /deos/output/requests/preview-local-1.json >/dev/null <<'\\''JSON'\\''
{\"action\":\"preview\",\"assets\":\"dist\"}
JSON
deos-implementation /deos/output/requests/preview-local-1.json'"
